component.name: AgentDictate
component.summary: Fast native Linux dictation for AI coding prompts

description.p: AgentDictate records speech, transcribes it with OpenAI, safely checkpoints recovery data, and pastes the result into the focused application.

ul.li: The navigation labels in the window are left-aligned.
The input-access check no longer mistakes a webcam or power button for a keyboard it cannot read.
The input-access rule lets your session read AgentDictate's own virtual keyboard, and nothing else new.
Building from source needs the xkbcommon development packages; the linker workaround is gone.
A first-run Setup in the window checks your OpenAI API key, tests the microphone and grants input access, and Home shows whether dictation is ready or what to fix.
Dictation is faster and sturdier: audio is encoded while you record, a dropped connection is retried once, and the app stays responsive while OpenAI transcribes.
When a dictation is not pasted, the overlay and a notification say so, and Paste last dictation in the tray, a notification or a keyboard shortcut pastes it again.
History can be searched, keeps transcripts as long as you choose, and Delete removes them for good. A new Words screen teaches AgentDictate how to spell names.
Settings apply as soon as you change them, and a recording longer than 5 seconds that you cancel with Esc waits in Recovery for a day.
The ChatGPT subscription route, the ChatGPT history import, text cleanup and Replacements are gone; Replacements moved into Words.
